items.headline: YouTube's latest redesign moves Subscriptions out of the bottom tab bar.
items.what: In YouTube's latest app redesign, Subscriptions is no longer in the bottom bar. Shorts and the Upload button stay there. Android Authority reports that users are complaining because they say they use Subscriptions more than either of those.
items.why: Giving a tab-bar slot to a surface the company wants to grow, rather than one people use every day, can cause a backlash. The same risk applies if a travel app moves Trips or My Bookings out of the tab bar to make room for inspiration or deals.

sources.title: Where’s my Subscriptions tab? Users are furious about YouTube’s latest redesign

zh.headline: YouTube 最新改版把「订阅」移出了底部标签栏。
zh.what: YouTube 最新改版后，「订阅」不再出现在底部栏，Shorts 和上传按钮仍保留在底部栏。据 Android Authority 报道，不少用户表示自己使用「订阅」的频率高于这两个入口，因此对改版不满。
zh.why: 把标签栏位置让给公司想推的功能、而不是用户每天都用的功能，容易引起反弹。旅行 App 如果为了给灵感或特价频道腾位置，把「行程」或「我的订单」移出标签栏，也会面临同样的风险。

items.headline: macOS 27.3 shows Live Activities in the menu bar on Macs without a Dynamic Island.
items.what: The new touchscreen MacBook Pro shows Live Activities in its Dynamic Island. In the macOS 27.3 beta, other Apple silicon Macs show Live Activities in the menu bar instead, for apps such as Apple Music.
items.why: A Live Activity for a train departure or flight can appear in more places than the iPhone Dynamic Island. Check that its compact layout still reads at menu-bar size, with the platform or gate and the time shown first.

sources.title: macOS 27.3 Brings Live Activities to Macs Without Dynamic Island

zh.headline: macOS 27.3 在没有灵动岛的 Mac 上，把实时活动放进菜单栏显示。
zh.what: 新款触屏 MacBook Pro 在灵动岛中显示实时活动（Live Activities）。macOS 27.3 测试版让其他 Apple 芯片 Mac 在菜单栏显示实时活动，Apple Music 等应用已支持。
zh.why: 火车发车、航班这类实时活动的显示位置不再限于 iPhone 灵动岛。需要确认紧凑布局在菜单栏尺寸下仍然清楚，站台或登机口和时间放在最前面。

items.headline: Apple adds retention messages to the App Store subscription cancellation flow.
items.what: When a subscriber starts to cancel, the cancellation flow can now show a message from the app that reminds them what the subscription gives them. The message can include text, images or a special offer. Developers set these messages up in App Store Connect.
items.why: Travel apps with a paid membership or subscription now control one screen in a cancellation flow that Apple owns. Teams need to write that message and design its image and offer to match the in-app membership pages.

sources.title: Now available: Retention messages for subscriptions

zh.headline: Apple 在 App Store 订阅取消流程中加入挽留信息。
zh.what: 用户开始取消订阅时，取消流程里会出现一条由 App 提供的信息，提醒用户这项订阅的价值。信息可以包含文字、图片或专属优惠。开发者在 App Store Connect 中配置这些内容。
zh.why: 对于有付费会员或订阅的旅行 App，原本由系统掌控的取消流程里多了一个可以自己设计的页面。团队需要准备这条挽留信息的文案、配图和优惠，并与 App 内会员页面的视觉保持一致。

items.headline: Google Messages starts testing a redesigned pinned chats area in beta.
items.what: Google Messages is rolling out a new design for pinned chats at the top of the conversation list. The change is currently limited to beta users.
items.why: Pinned chats show how to give a few priority items their own visual treatment above a long list. A travel app faces the same layout question when it shows upcoming trips above past bookings in trip management.

sources.title: Google Messages’ pinned chats UI makeover is finally landing for users

zh.headline: Google Messages 在测试版中上线重新设计的置顶聊天区域。
zh.what: Google Messages 正在推送置顶聊天的新设计，置顶聊天位于会话列表顶部。目前只有测试版用户能看到这一改动。
zh.why: 置顶聊天的做法是：在长列表上方，用单独的视觉样式突出少数几条重点内容。旅行 App 的行程管理页在把即将出行的行程放在历史订单上方时，也要处理同样的布局问题。

items.headline: Google confirms a new Family Hub section in Android Settings.
items.what: Google has confirmed a Family Hub feature that will appear in the Android Settings menu. The rollout has not started yet, and 9to5Google published an early gallery of the screens.
items.why: Android is grouping family-related controls in one Settings hub. This is a useful reference for where a booking app puts saved travellers, family members and shared trips in its account and settings screens.

sources.title: Google confirms Android’s new ‘Family Hub’ feature, and this is what it looks like [Gallery]

zh.headline: Google 确认 Android 设置中将新增「Family Hub」入口。
zh.what: Google 确认 Android 设置菜单将加入 Family Hub 功能，目前尚未开始推送。9to5Google 提前发布了界面截图。
zh.why: Android 把家庭相关的设置集中到一个入口。预订类 App 在「我的」和设置页中安排常用旅客、家庭成员和共享行程时，可以参考这种做法。

items.headline: Samsung's One UI 9 redesigns the Galaxy Z Flip cover screen, and many owners are unhappy.
items.what: The One UI 9 update, based on Android 17, changes how the Galaxy Z Flip's cover screen looks and works. Android Authority reports a wave of complaints from owners after the update.
items.why: If your app shows boarding passes, tickets or trip status on the Flip's cover screen, check that those views still work after One UI 9 changes how the screen is laid out.

sources.title: Samsung changed Galaxy Z Flip’s cover screen with One UI 9, and a lot of owners are not happy

zh.headline: 三星 One UI 9 重新设计了 Galaxy Z Flip 的外屏，不少用户不满。
zh.what: 基于 Android 17 的 One UI 9 更新改变了 Galaxy Z Flip 外屏的样式和交互方式。据 Android Authority 报道，更新后大量用户提出了抱怨。
zh.why: 如果你的 App 在 Flip 外屏上显示登机牌、车票或行程状态，需要确认 One UI 9 调整外屏布局后，这些界面仍能正常使用。

items.headline: Safari adds a Vertical Tabs layout and Adaptive Dark Mode in the iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3 and macOS 27.3 betas.
items.what: Users can choose Vertical Tabs instead of the standard horizontal tab bar. MacRumors says the layout suits the iPhone Duo's larger display but is not limited to that device. The betas also add Adaptive Dark Mode and Siri AI Custom Actions to Safari.
items.why: Apple is putting a vertical tab list on iPhone as screens get wider, so results lists and filter layouts should be tested at iPhone Duo widths. Web-based pages such as hosted checkout are worth checking under Adaptive Dark Mode once its behaviour is clear.

sources.title: iOS 27.3 Adds Vertical Tabs and Adaptive Dark Mode to Safari
iOS 27.3 and macOS 27.3 add Vertical Tabs, Adaptive Dark Mode, and more to Safari

zh.headline: Safari 在 iOS 27.3、iPadOS 27.3 和 macOS 27.3 beta 中新增竖向标签页布局和 Adaptive Dark Mode。
zh.what: 用户可以用 Vertical Tabs 代替原来的横向标签栏。据 MacRumors，这个布局适合 iPhone Duo 的大屏，但不限于这款机型。这批 beta 还为 Safari 加入了 Adaptive Dark Mode 和 Siri AI Custom Actions。
zh.why: 屏幕变宽后，Apple 在 iPhone 上也用了竖向标签列表，搜索结果列表和筛选布局应该在 iPhone Duo 的宽度下测试。具体机制明确后，也值得检查网页收银台等 Web 页面在 Adaptive Dark Mode 下的显示效果。

items.headline: Apple's redesigned Health app returns in the iOS 27.3 beta, with new Insights and Longevity tabs.
items.what: Apple previewed the redesign in September and tested it in the iOS 27.2 beta, then removed it before that update shipped. iOS 27.3 beta 1 brings it back with new Insights and Longevity tabs that show more information about the user's health. Apple also announced expanded language support for the redesigned app.
items.why: Apple gave interpreted information (Insights, Longevity) its own top-level tabs. This is a useful reference when deciding whether personalised trip suggestions get a tab of their own or sit inside trip management.

sources.title: Redesigned Health app expands language support
iOS 27.3 Beta Brings Back Apple's Redesigned Health App

zh.headline: Apple 重新设计的健康 App 在 iOS 27.3 beta 中回归，新增 Insights 和 Longevity 两个标签页。
zh.what: 这次改版在 9 月预览，曾在 iOS 27.2 beta 中测试，但正式版发布前被撤下。iOS 27.3 beta 1 重新加入了新版健康 App，新增的 Insights 和 Longevity 标签页展示更多健康信息。Apple 同时宣布新版 App 支持更多语言。
zh.why: Apple 把解读后的信息（Insights、Longevity）放到了一级标签页。设计行程管理时，如果在考虑个性化出行建议要不要单独占一个 Tab，可以参考这个做法。

items.headline: iOS 27.3 brings the iPhone Duo's redesigned StandBy to iPhone 11 and newer.
items.what: StandBy shows information at a glance when an iPhone is charging in landscape. Apple says the redesigned StandBy, first introduced on the iPhone Duo, comes to every iPhone that can run iOS 27.3, which is now in beta.
items.why: StandBy is where widgets and Live Activities appear on a charging phone, so trip countdown widgets and departure Live Activities should be rechecked in the new layout.

sources.title: iOS 27.3 Adding New StandBy Mode Features to iPhone 11 and Newer
iOS 27.3 brings the iPhone Duo’s revamped StandBy to other iPhones

zh.headline: iOS 27.3 把 iPhone Duo 上重新设计的 StandBy 带到 iPhone 11 及更新机型。
zh.what: StandBy 在 iPhone 横放充电时显示一目了然的信息。Apple 表示，最早在 iPhone Duo 上推出的新版 StandBy，将覆盖所有支持 iOS 27.3 的 iPhone，目前处于 beta 阶段。
zh.why: 手机充电时，小组件和实时活动都会出现在 StandBy 里，行程倒计时小组件和出发提醒类实时活动需要在新布局下重新检查。

items.headline: iOS 27.3 adds Reachability to the iPhone Duo for one-handed use.
items.what: On the iPhone Duo's outer screen, Reachability shifts the content on the left or right side toward the user's thumb. It is in the first iOS 27.3 beta and is switched on or off in Settings > Accessibility > Touch.
items.why: Apple's answer to the Duo's wide outer screen is to move content toward the thumb, so actions at the far edges are hard to reach. Keep primary buttons such as Book or Select seat near the bottom centre on wide layouts.

sources.title: iPhone Duo Gets Reachability in iOS 27.3 Beta
iOS 27.3 introduces new iPhone Duo feature for one-handed use

zh.headline: iOS 27.3 为 iPhone Duo 加入 Reachability，方便单手操作。
zh.what: 在 iPhone Duo 的外屏上，Reachability 可以把左侧或右侧的内容移到拇指附近。该功能出现在首个 iOS 27.3 beta 中，可在 设置 > 辅助功能 > 触控 中开关。
zh.why: Apple 对外屏变宽的解决方法是把内容移向拇指，说明屏幕两侧边缘的操作很难够到。在宽屏布局下，“预订”“选座”这类主按钮应放在靠下居中的位置。

items.headline: Middle Eastern fintech app Tabby gets a new identity from Ragged Edge.
items.what: Branding studio Ragged Edge has created a new identity for Tabby, which BP&O describes as playful. Tabby was founded in 2019 and now calls itself "the money app that lets you spend, send, save and boss money around".
items.why: Where Tabby is offered as a payment method, its logo in the checkout payment list will need updating to the new identity.

sources.title: Ragged Edge creates a playful new identity for Middle Eastern fintech app Tabby

zh.headline: 中东金融科技 App Tabby 启用 Ragged Edge 设计的新品牌形象。
zh.what: 品牌设计工作室 Ragged Edge 为 Tabby 设计了新形象，BP&O 评价其风格轻松活泼。Tabby 成立于 2019 年，现在自称“让你消费、转账、储蓄、掌控钱的理财 App”。
zh.why: 如果收银台提供 Tabby 作为支付方式，支付方式列表里的 Tabby 标识需要换成新版。

items.headline: Swiss Post gets a custom typeface from Swiss Typefaces.
items.what: Swiss Typefaces spent three years on the font, which Creative Boom describes as warmer and friendlier.
items.why: A national service brand chose a warmer custom typeface over a neutral one. That is a reference point when weighing a proprietary brand font against system fonts for app text.

sources.title: Swiss Typefaces crafts a warmer, friendlier custom font for Swiss Post

zh.headline: Swiss Post 启用 Swiss Typefaces 定制的新字体。
zh.what: Swiss Typefaces 用了三年时间设计这款字体，Creative Boom 称其更温暖、更亲切。
zh.why: 一个国家级服务品牌选择了更温暖的定制字体，而不是中性字体。权衡 App 文字是用自有品牌字体还是系统字体时，可以参考。

items.headline: Google is rolling out gradient app icons for Messages, Phone and Contacts.
items.what: Google is replacing the icons for its Contacts, Messages and Phone apps with gradient versions. The new Messages icon arrives in the app's latest update. This follows Google's gradient redesigns of its Workspace and Pixel app icons earlier this year.
items.why: Google is moving its core Android apps to one icon style, so a flat travel app icon will sit next to more gradient icons on Android home screens. That is worth checking when you review how your Android icon reads beside the system apps.

sources.title: Google rolling out gradient icon redesigns for Contacts, Messages, and Phone
Google Messages update rolling out new app icon with gradient design

zh.headline: Google 为 Messages、Phone 和 Contacts 推出渐变风格应用图标。
zh.what: Google 正在将 Contacts、Messages 和 Phone 三款应用的图标替换为渐变版本，Messages 的新图标已随最新版本更新出现。此前，Google 已在今年早些时候把 Workspace 和 Pixel 系列应用图标改为渐变风格。
zh.why: Google 正把 Android 核心应用统一为同一种图标风格，Android 桌面上的渐变图标会越来越多。评估 Android 端应用图标时，可以看看扁平风格的旅行应用图标放在这些系统应用旁边是否还够醒目。

items.headline: X replaces its alternative app icon set on iPhone and iPad with more than a dozen new options.
items.what: Today's update to X for iPhone and iPad overhauls the alternative app icons that users can pick in place of the default icon. The new set has more than a dozen options. The app has offered alternative icons since it was called Twitter.
items.why: iOS alternative icons let users personalise an app without touching the core brand mark. A travel app could use the same mechanism for loyalty tiers or seasonal campaigns while keeping the default icon unchanged.

sources.title: X for iPhone and iPad just added over a dozen new app icon options

zh.headline: X 在 iPhone 和 iPad 上更新了可替换图标，新增十余款选项。
zh.what: X 的 iPhone 和 iPad 版本在今天的更新中重做了可替换应用图标，用户可用它们替代默认图标。新图标组共有十余款。这项功能从应用还叫 Twitter 时就已存在。
zh.why: iOS 的可替换图标能让用户个性化应用，而不改动主品牌标识。旅行应用也可以用这一机制配合会员等级或季节性活动，同时保持默认图标不变。

items.headline: Apple Music 7.0 for Android brings the Liquid Glass design and the new app icon.
items.what: Apple Music 7.0 is rolling out on Android with a redesign in Liquid Glass, the visual style Apple introduced on its own platforms. The update also brings the new Apple Music icon from this year's rebrand to Android. It arrives after a month of beta testing.
items.why: Apple chose to bring its own iOS design language to Android instead of adopting Material Design there. A travel app with iOS and Android versions faces the same choice for its tab bar, bottom sheets and app icon: match its own brand across platforms, or follow the host platform's conventions.

sources.title: Apple Music 7.0 for Android rolls out with Liquid Glass redesign

zh.headline: Apple Music 7.0 安卓版换上 Liquid Glass 设计和新应用图标。
zh.what: Apple Music 7.0 安卓版正在陆续推送，界面改用 Liquid Glass 风格，也就是苹果在自家系统上推出的视觉语言。这次更新同时把今年品牌焕新后的新图标带到了安卓端。正式版推出前已经过一个月的 Beta 测试。
zh.why: 苹果把自己的 iOS 设计语言直接带到了安卓，没有改用 Material Design。双端旅行 App 也要做同样的取舍：底部标签栏、底部弹层和应用图标，是在两端统一自家品牌风格，还是遵循各自平台的规范。

items.headline: The New York Times marks its 175th anniversary with a custom 175 mark and identity system.
items.what: The anniversary identity is built around a custom 175 mark. It is designed to work across editorial, opinion, advertising, events and marketing, and it accompanies a set of events and a campaign.
items.why: This is a model for a time-limited campaign mark designed as a full system for several surfaces at once. A travel brand could apply the same approach to an anniversary or sale event, covering home-screen modules, banners, push artwork and emails from one set of rules instead of one-off badges.

sources.title: The New York Times turns 175

zh.headline: 《纽约时报》为创刊 175 周年推出定制 175 标志和整套视觉识别。
zh.what: 这套周年识别以一个定制的 175 标志为核心，可用于编辑内容、评论版、广告、活动和营销等场景，并配合一系列活动和广告宣传一起推出。
zh.why: 这是限时活动标志按完整系统来设计、同时覆盖多个触点的一个例子。旅行品牌做周年庆或大促时，可以用同一套规则统一首页运营位、横幅、推送配图和邮件，而不是每处单独做一个角标。

items.headline: YouTube on Google TV starts showing YouTube Music with a red logo.
items.what: 9to5Google reports that an update to the YouTube app on Google TV, either rolling out or still in testing, gives YouTube Music a red logo. The reviewer says the logo stands out sharply from the rest of the interface.
items.why: Cross-selling a sibling product, such as hotels inside a rail app, raises the same question. A single high-contrast brand mark among neutral entries draws attention but can look like noise, so the colour and weight of cross-sell entry points next to core features need deliberate choices.

sources.title: YouTube for Google TV update gives YouTube Music a distracting red logo I can’t stand

zh.headline: Google TV 上的 YouTube 开始用红色标志显示 YouTube Music。
zh.what: 据 9to5Google 报道，Google TV 版 YouTube 应用的一次更新（可能正在推送，也可能仍在测试）给 YouTube Music 换上了红色标志。作者认为它和界面其他部分反差过大。
zh.why: 旅行 App 做交叉推荐时会遇到同样的问题，比如在火车票 App 里放酒店入口。一个高对比度的品牌标志放在一排中性入口里很显眼，但也可能显得突兀。交叉推荐入口和核心功能并列时，颜色和视觉权重需要专门设计。

items.headline: Apple brings touch input to the Mac and publishes guidance for adapting apps to it.
items.what: Apple announced its first touchscreen Mac, the MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, on October 28. Alongside it, Apple released developer videos, articles and resources on preparing apps for touch on Mac, with live Group Labs sessions starting in November.
items.why: If your booking app has a Mac version, controls built for a pointer will now also be tapped with a finger. That affects date pickers, seat maps and small filter chips in the results list. Watch the new sessions for Apple's guidance on target sizes and on controls that rely on hover.

sources.title: Say hello to Touch on Mac
Apple releases touchscreen Mac developer videos, with live sessions coming in November

zh.headline: Apple 让 Mac 支持触控，并发布了应用适配指南。
zh.what: Apple 于 10 月 28 日发布首款触屏 Mac，即配备 PROLED XDR 显示屏的 MacBook Pro。同时，Apple 推出了一批开发者视频、文章和资源，介绍如何让应用适配 Mac 触控，11 月起还会举办 Group Labs 线上答疑。
zh.why: 如果你们的预订应用有 Mac 版，原本为鼠标设计的控件现在也会被手指点按，日期选择器、选座图和结果列表里的小筛选标签都会受影响。建议关注这些课程中关于点击区域尺寸和悬停交互的说明。

items.headline: Chrome rolls out "Suggested by Gemini" autofill, which fills in more information on web forms.
items.what: Chrome can now use Gemini and Personal Intelligence to autofill more information than standard autofill handles. Autofill suggestions from Gemini carry the "Suggested by Gemini" name. Google first previewed the feature in May.
items.why: Traveller-detail and checkout forms on the web may arrive partly filled by Gemini. Clear field labels and correct autocomplete attributes will affect what gets filled. Give users an easy way to review prefilled passenger names and document numbers before they pay.

sources.title: Google Chrome rolling out ‘Suggested by Gemini’ autofill

zh.headline: Chrome 推出“Suggested by Gemini”自动填充，可以在网页表单里填入更多信息。
zh.what: Chrome 现在可以借助 Gemini 和 Personal Intelligence，自动填写比原有自动填充更多的信息。这类建议以“Suggested by Gemini”的名义出现。该功能今年 5 月曾预告过。
zh.why: 网页端的乘客信息和支付表单可能会被 Gemini 预先填好一部分。表单字段的标签是否清楚、autocomplete 属性是否正确，会决定填进去的内容。付款前应让用户方便地核对预填的乘客姓名和证件号。

items.headline: Microsoft gives Copilot a new identity that positions it as a work tool.
items.what: The Brand Identity reports that the new Copilot identity is built on dynamic motion geometry. The identity is aimed at enterprise productivity. The source gives no further detail on the logo or the rollout.
items.why: Copilot's identity makes motion a core brand element rather than decoration. That approach is worth considering if your brand system is being extended to loading states and app transitions.

sources.title: Microsoft’s identity for Copilot positions it as a tool for work

zh.headline: Microsoft 为 Copilot 推出新品牌形象，定位为工作工具。
zh.what: 据 The Brand Identity 报道，新的 Copilot 品牌形象以动态几何图形为基础，面向企业办公场景。报道没有提供更多关于标志和上线安排的细节。
zh.why: Copilot 把动效当作品牌的核心元素，而不只是装饰。如果你们正在把品牌规范延伸到加载状态和页面转场，可以参考这种做法。

items.headline: Google Photos redesigns its Collections tab so users can customise it.
items.what: Google Photos is rolling out a redesign of the Collections tab on Android and iOS that lets users customise the tab. It follows the floating navigation bar the app introduced in July.
items.why: A travel app's Trips or Saved tab mixes bookings, wishlists and documents, much like a photo library tab. This redesign is a current reference for letting users rearrange a library-style tab instead of fixing its sections.

sources.title: Google Photos rolls out customizable redesign of your ‘Collections’ tab

zh.headline: Google Photos 改版「Collections」标签页，支持用户自定义。
zh.what: Google Photos 正在 Android 和 iOS 上推出「Collections」标签页的改版，用户可以自定义这个标签页。此前该应用在 7 月已改用悬浮导航栏。
zh.why: 旅行 App 的「行程」或「收藏」页同样混合了订单、心愿单和证件等内容，和相册的合集页类似。这次改版可以作为参考：这类内容汇总页是否应该交给用户自己调整分区，而不是由产品写死。

items.headline: iOS 27.2 adds age verification by selfie.
items.what: iOS 27.2 introduces a feature that lets iPhone users verify their age by taking a selfie. The candidate text does not describe the screens or where the check appears.
items.why: Some travel products are age-gated, such as car hire or youth and senior rail discounts. A system-level selfie check may become an option alongside an app's own document upload step, so it is worth watching how Apple exposes it to apps.

sources.title: iOS 27.2 introduces new age verification feature using selfie

zh.headline: iOS 27.2 新增自拍年龄验证。
zh.what: iOS 27.2 推出了通过自拍验证年龄的功能。现有资料没有说明具体界面，也没有说明验证入口出现在哪里。
zh.why: 租车、青年或长者火车票优惠等旅行产品有年龄限制。系统级的自拍验证将来可能成为 App 自建证件上传流程之外的另一种选择，值得关注 Apple 如何向第三方 App 开放这项能力。

items.headline: Google redesigns the plus button in Gemini Live on Android to make adding photos and files easier.
items.what: Google is rolling out a small redesign of the 'plus' control in Gemini Live on Android, so users can attach photos and files to a live conversation more easily. It follows several other Gemini interface updates this month.
items.why: Travel apps with in-app support chat face the same question of how visible the attachment entry point should be. Users there often need to send booking screenshots, receipts or ID photos mid-conversation.

sources.title: Gemini Live redesign makes it easier to add context to chats

zh.headline: Google 在 Android 版 Gemini Live 中重新设计了加号按钮，添加照片和文件更方便。
zh.what: Google 正在为 Android 版 Gemini Live 推送一次小幅改版，调整了“加号”入口，用户在实时对话中添加照片和文件更顺手。这是本月 Gemini 一系列界面更新中的又一项。
zh.why: 旅行 App 的在线客服对话也要决定附件入口的显眼程度。用户在对话中常常需要发送订单截图、发票或证件照片。

items.headline: Apple Music gets its first rebrand since launching in 2015, with a new logo made from sound.
items.what: Apple made the new Apple Music logo with musician Fred Again by passing sound waves through a pool of oil. The resulting mark has a wave-like form. This is the service's first rebrand since it launched in 2015.
items.why: The logo comes from a physical process and has a story behind it, where most brand marks are drawn shapes. If you are refreshing a travel brand, you need to choose whether the mark should carry a story like this or stay a simple shape that still reads at app-icon size.

sources.title: Apple Music unveils logo that was physically "made by sound"

zh.headline: Apple Music 推出 2015 年上线以来的首次品牌焕新，新 logo 由声音“制作”而成。
zh.what: Apple 与音乐人 Fred Again 合作，让声波穿过一池油，由此生成新的 Apple Music logo，整体呈波浪形态。这是该服务自 2015 年上线以来的第一次品牌升级。
zh.why: 大多数品牌标识是直接画出来的图形，这个 logo 则来自一个真实的物理过程，背后有一段故事。旅行品牌做焕新时需要做出取舍：标识要不要承载这样的来源故事，还是保持简单图形，确保在 App 图标尺寸下依然清晰可辨。

items.headline: Google redesigns the side panel and settings in the Gemini app for Android.
items.what: The Gemini app on Android has rolled out new designs for its side panel and its settings screens. The change follows the earlier Spark-to-Task update to the app.
items.why: Travel apps use a side panel or account menu to hold past trips, saved items and preferences. Gemini's new grouping is a current Google reference to check when you reorganise your own account and settings screens.

sources.title: Gemini for Android rolls out side panel and settings redesign

zh.headline: Google 为 Android 版 Gemini 应用重新设计了侧边栏和设置页。
zh.what: Android 版 Gemini 应用已上线新的侧边栏和设置页设计。这次改版是在此前的 Spark-to-Task 更新之后推出的。
zh.why: 出行应用通常把历史行程、收藏和偏好设置放在侧边栏或账户菜单里。重新梳理自家账户页和设置页时，可以参考 Gemini 这次的分组方式，它是 Google 当下的做法。

items.headline: OnePlus phones move from OxygenOS to ColorOS with the stable Android 17 update.
items.what: OnePlus has started rolling out stable Android 17 to the OnePlus 15 and OnePlus Pad 4, and the update switches these devices from OxygenOS to ColorOS. They are the first OnePlus devices to make the change, which ends OxygenOS.
items.why: On updated OnePlus devices, your booking app's notifications and widgets will now appear inside ColorOS system UI. Test those on ColorOS rather than OxygenOS.

sources.title: OnePlus starts rolling out stable Android 17 updates early, marking the end of OxygenOS

zh.headline: OnePlus 随 Android 17 正式版从 OxygenOS 切换到 ColorOS。
zh.what: OnePlus 开始向 OnePlus 15 和 OnePlus Pad 4 推送 Android 17 正式版，系统随之从 OxygenOS 换成 ColorOS。这两款是首批切换的设备，OxygenOS 将就此停用。
zh.why: 在升级后的 OnePlus 设备上，订票应用的通知和小组件会显示在 ColorOS 的系统界面中。测试时应改用 ColorOS 验证，不要再以 OxygenOS 为准。
